inspectionMethod: Manual original-resolution pixel inspection of current mobile, desktop, and reduced-motion full-page renders after lazy-content priming

findings.message: The first viewport keeps one filled install action and a clear focal headline; the full page preserves the Choose-to-Prove rhythm, real showcase imagery, and readable dark/light section transforms.
The reduced-motion render retains every section and action with no content hidden, collapsed, or visually displaced.
